title: What The Black Dots Around Your Windshield Are Doing
hook: A black border you have looked past ten thousand times is holding the glass on.

cast.note: Bill is a passenger noticing the edge of the glass for the first time.

scenes.note: Start INSIDE the car looking up at the glass edge, which is where a viewer has actually seen this.

beats.action: view up at a windshield top edge from inside; the black band runs across frame
the solid band highlights; camera tracks along it
the band breaks into its dot gradient; each dot pops in along the fade
the camera drifts along the black band toward where the dots begin
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: Bill leans in from the passenger seat, nose near the glass
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Cross-section through the glass edge. Glass, ceramic layer, adhesive, car body — four labelled bands.

beats.action: the glass edge rotates into cross-section
the ceramic layer fills in black and labels itself
the urethane bead draws in beneath it, gripping the body
the cross-section rotates slightly so each layer separates clearly
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the adhesive bead squeezes slightly as the glass seats down onto it
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: The UV threat, shown as light that stops at the black layer. Restrained — no drama.

beats.action: sun rays angle down toward the cross-section
rays reaching bare adhesive turn it brittle and grey
the ceramic band blocks the rays; the adhesive under it stays intact
the sun climbs a little higher over the cross-section
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Beat of anticipation. Hold on the dot pattern alone before the reason arrives.

beats.action: the dot gradient isolates on a plain field, large
the dots pulse once in sequence, from dense to sparse

scenes.note: Heat map. A HARD edge cracks; the dotted edge does not. Show both, side by side.

beats.action: two glass panels appear side by side, one hard-edged, one dotted
heat blooms coral from the black side of both panels
the hard-edged panel cracks along the boundary line
the dotted panel grades smoothly from hot to cool and survives; hard cut
the heat bloom spreads further across both panels
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the crack on the hard-edged panel creeps a little further
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap
